name: Tumerok Fort (51.1S, 82.0W)
title: 51.1S, 82.0W - Tumerok Fort
summary: The Overlord's Sword Tumerok fort on an 80 m mesa in the West Dires 2.5 km north-west of Ayan Baqur: ten timber halls, gate halls and palisades on the mesa top with two 30.75 m stone spire towers on its north rim at (4812, 12276) and (4836, 12276) (a Sturdy Steel Chest in one); the slopes fall 70 m to the north and west into forest.

site.name: Tumerok Fort (51.1S, 82.0W)
site.notes: Derived teleport on the mesa top 55 m south-south-west of the fort centre, 12 m from the nearest hut.

shots.standingOrder: Look up the north slope of the mesa at the two Tumerok spire towers on its rim against the golden sky, creeping 2 m closer; keep 4 m above the slope.
shots.notes: Low angle from the north slope of the mesa (camera 9-10 m above the slope, 75 m from the towers) looking up at the two 30.75 m spire towers on the mesa rim against the golden sky (0.78), creeping 2 m closer; the western sun side-lights them from the right.
